label: 影片 12
theme: 為什麼有些人方向感比較好？
themeEn: Why do some people have a better sense of direction than others?

ex.en: In July of 2025, top athletes competed in a kilometers-long race— but it had no set path.
ex.zh: 2025 年 7 月，頂尖運動員參加了一場好幾公里長的賽跑，但這場比賽沒有固定的路線。

tips.t: compete in a race／with rivals 參加比賽／和對手競爭。

ex.en: That's because it was the World Orienteering Championships, and participants equipped with only maps and compasses were expected to find their way between far-off checkpoints at high speeds,
ex.zh: 因為那是世界定向越野錦標賽，參賽者只帶著地圖和指南針，必須高速在遙遠的檢查點之間找到路，

tips.t: be equipped with 配備～：rooms equipped with Wi-Fi 附 Wi-Fi 的房間（飯店介紹必考）。

ex.en: This might sound a little daunting.
ex.zh: 這聽起來可能有點嚇人。

tips.t: a daunting task 艱鉅的任務。

ex.en: your brain has a built-in navigation system that facilitates spatial skills, from sensing which direction is north to map reading and route learning.
ex.zh: 你的大腦都內建一套導航系統，幫助你發揮空間能力，從判斷哪邊是北方，到看地圖、記路線。

tips.t: facilitate communication 促進溝通（Day 09 impede 的反義字）。

ex.en: It consists of two major parts: the striatum and the hippocampus.
ex.zh: 它由兩個主要部分組成：紋狀體和海馬迴。

tips.t: The committee consists of five members. 委員會由五人組成（不能用被動）。

ex.en: With repetition, it comes to associate specific stimuli and actions with certain responses and outcomes, linking these cues with set routes.
ex.zh: 經過反覆練習，它會把特定的刺激和動作，與特定的反應和結果連結起來，把這些線索和固定路線綁在一起。

tips.t: associate A with B 把 A 和 B 聯想在一起；sales associate 店員（徵才常見）。

ex.en: This forms navigation habits; for example, when you automatically take the same sequence of turns on your way home.
ex.zh: 這就形成了導航習慣，例如你回家時會自動按同樣的順序轉彎。

tips.t: in sequence 依序；a sequence of events 一連串事件。

ex.en: Together, the breakthrough discoveries that put place and grid cells on the map earned the 2014 Nobel Prize.
ex.zh: 這些讓位置細胞和網格細胞廣為人知的突破性發現，共同獲得了 2014 年的諾貝爾獎。

tips.t: a major breakthrough in research 研究上的重大突破；put ~ on the map＝讓～出名。

ex.en: But while the striatum and hippocampus form a navigation system that allows our brains to adapt between strategies depending on the task, we still struggle to find our ways.
ex.zh: 但即使紋狀體和海馬迴組成了一套讓大腦能依任務切換策略的導航系統，我們還是常常找不到路。

tips.t: adapt to change 適應改變；注意 adapt（適應）和 adopt（採納，Day 08）只差一個字母。

ex.en: Twin studies suggest that genetics account for around 60% of the variation in our navigation abilities.
ex.zh: 雙胞胎研究顯示，我們導航能力的差異大約有 60% 來自基因。

tips.t: Sales in Asia account for 40% of revenue. 亞洲銷售占營收 40%（圖表題必考）。

ex.en: These abilities appear independent of general intelligence, suggesting that navigation is its own distinct cognitive skill.
ex.zh: 這些能力似乎和一般智力無關，顯示導航是一種獨立的認知技能。

fam: distinction n. 區別（Day 07 滿分單字）

tips.t: distinct from 與～不同；independent of＝不受～影響。

ex.en: Those who successfully complete the training have been observed to experience significant hippocampal growth.
ex.zh: 成功完成訓練的人，被觀察到海馬迴有明顯的增長。

tips.t: a significant increase in sales 銷售大幅增加（財報必考）。

ex.en: While GPS devices reliably get us around, they lead to worse spatial reconstructions than verbal directions and paper maps do.
ex.zh: 雖然 GPS 裝置能可靠地帶我們到處走，但和口頭指路、紙本地圖相比，會讓我們在腦中重建空間的能力變差。

fam: rely on phr. 依靠（影片 11）

tips.t: a reliably fast service 一向快速可靠的服務。

ex.en: By allowing our brains to engage less actively with environmental cues, GPS may degrade the hippocampal navigation system and impair our own internal sense of direction.
ex.zh: GPS 讓大腦較少主動運用環境線索，可能會削弱海馬迴的導航系統，損害我們自己內在的方向感。

tips.t: impair performance 影響表現；hearing-impaired 聽障的。本句 degrade＝降低品質。

ex.en: So, to help improve it, you can try putting your GPS away on more familiar routes and paying attention to distant landmarks.
ex.zh: 所以要改善方向感，你可以試著在比較熟悉的路線上把 GPS 收起來，多注意遠處的地標。

tips.t: be familiar with 熟悉～（Day 07 滿分單字）；familiarize yourself with the manual 請熟讀手冊。

cloze.s: your brain has a built-in navigation system that ___ spatial skills, from sensing which direction is north to map reading and route learning.
This forms navigation habits; for example, when you automatically take the same ___ of turns on your way home.
Together, the ___ discoveries that put place and grid cells on the map earned the 2014 Nobel Prize.
These abilities appear independent of general intelligence, suggesting that navigation is its own ___ cognitive skill.
Those who successfully complete the training have been observed to experience ___ hippocampal growth.
By allowing our brains to engage less actively with environmental cues, GPS may degrade the hippocampal navigation system and ___ our own internal sense of direction.
So, to help improve it, you can try putting your GPS away on more ___ routes and paying attention to distant landmarks.
